001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007@HistoryLogProps(
008    opCode = 213,
009    displayName = "CGM Join Session GX",
010    internalName = "LID_CGM_JOIN_SESSION_GX"
011)
012public class CgmJoinSessionHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
013
014    private long currentTransmitterTime;
015    private long sessionStartTime;
016    private int sessionJoinReasonRaw;
017    private int sessionDuration;
018
019    public CgmJoinSessionHistoryLog() {}
020    public CgmJoinSessionHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
021        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0, 0, 0);
022    }
023
024    public CgmJoinSessionHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long currentTransmitterTime, long sessionStartTime, int sessionJoinReasonRaw, int sessionDuration) {
025        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
026        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, currentTransmitterTime, sessionStartTime, sessionJoinReasonRaw, sessionDuration);
027        this.currentTransmitterTime = currentTransmitterTime;
028        this.sessionStartTime = sessionStartTime;
029        this.sessionJoinReasonRaw = sessionJoinReasonRaw;
030        this.sessionDuration = sessionDuration;
031    }
032
033    public CgmJoinSessionHistoryLog(long currentTransmitterTime, long sessionStartTime, int sessionJoinReasonRaw, int sessionDuration) {
034        this(0, 0, currentTransmitterTime, sessionStartTime, sessionJoinReasonRaw, sessionDuration);
035    }
036
037    public int typeId() {
038        return 213;
039    }
040
041    /**
042     * <table border="1">
043     * <caption>Parsed fields for CgmJoinSessionHistoryLog:</caption>
044     * <tr><td><code>currentTransmitterTime</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
045     * <tr><td><code>sessionStartTime</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
046     * <tr><td><code>sessionJoinReasonRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[24] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
047     * <tr><td><code>sessionDuration</code></td><td><code>raw[25] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
048     * </table>
049     */
050    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
051        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
052        this.cargo = raw;
053        parseBase(raw);
054        this.currentTransmitterTime = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
055        this.sessionStartTime = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
056        this.sessionJoinReasonRaw = raw[24] & 0xFF;
057        this.sessionDuration = raw[25] & 0xFF;
058
059    }
060
061    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
062        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0, 0, 0);
063    }
064
065    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long currentTransmitterTime, long sessionStartTime, int sessionJoinReasonRaw, int sessionDuration) {
066        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
067            new byte[]{(byte) 213, 0},
068            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
069            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
070            Bytes.toUint32(currentTransmitterTime),
071            Bytes.toUint32(sessionStartTime),
072            new byte[]{0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0},
073            new byte[]{(byte) sessionJoinReasonRaw},
074            new byte[]{(byte) sessionDuration}));
075    }
076
077    /**
078     * @return the current transmitter time, in seconds
079     */
080    public long getCurrentTransmitterTime() {
081        return currentTransmitterTime;
082    }
083
084    /**
085     * @return the session start time, in seconds
086     */
087    public long getSessionStartTime() {
088        return sessionStartTime;
089    }
090
091    public int getSessionJoinReasonRaw() {
092        return sessionJoinReasonRaw;
093    }
094
095    public enum SessionJoinReason {
096        DEXBLES_REASON_USER(0),
097        DEXBLES_REASON_UNKNOWN(1),
098        DEXBLES_REASON_TX_END_OF_LIFE(3),
099        DEXBLES_REASON_TRANSMITTER_ERROR(4),
100        DEXBLES_REASON_SESSION_STOP_SUCCESS(5),
101        DEXBLES_REASON_TRANSMITTER_NOT_IN_SESSION(6),
102        DEXBLES_REASON_NEW_SESSION_STARTED_SUCCESS(8),
103        DEXBLES_REASON_SESSION_STARTED_IN_PROGRESS(9),
104        DEXBLES_REASON_TRANSMITTER_IN_SESSION(10),
105        DEXBLES_REASON_BLESTACK_INVALID(11),
106        DEXBLES_REASON_NEW_AUTOCAL_SESSION_STARTED_SUCCESS(12),
107        DEXBLES_REASON_NO_AUTOCAL_SESSION_IN_PROGRESS(13),
108
109        ;
110        private int id;
111        SessionJoinReason(int id) {
112            this.id = id;
113        }
114
115        public static SessionJoinReason fromId(int id) {
116            for (SessionJoinReason r : values()) {
117                if (r.id == id) {
118                    return r;
119                }
120            }
121            return null;
122        }
123
124        public int getId() {
125            return id;
126        }
127    }
128
129    public SessionJoinReason getSessionJoinReason() {
130        return SessionJoinReason.fromId(sessionJoinReasonRaw);
131    }
132
133    /**
134     * @return the session duration, in days
135     */
136    public int getSessionDuration() {
137        return sessionDuration;
138    }
139}
